meta.name: e04-nulling-limit
meta.title: E04 · The two-channel null limit — one jammer vs two
meta.description: Adaptive nulling with Frontline RF on. A 2-channel bladeRF can steer ONE null; a 5-channel array can steer four. With a single jammer both cope; with two jammers in different bands the bladeRF can only null one, so the second still buries its co-band targets. The array (and the fused payload) keep nulling both.
